The '''Yuuzhan Vong advance scout ship''' was a vessel in the [[Yuuzhan Vong fleet]].<ref name="SWL18" />

==Characteristics==
It was dark in color, with several tendril-shaped structures hanging to each side of the vessel, and had a large, forward-facing hangar which could carry several [[Yorik-et]]-sized vessels.<ref name="SWL18" />

==History==
At some point during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] was captured by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] when his [[Transport/Legends|transport]] crashed inside one of their scout ships.<ref name="SWL18" />

He was tortured and experimented on while imprisoned on the vessel, and during his time there, encountered the exiled [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-[[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Vergere]]. They had several discussions on the topic of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and the [[Sith Order]] and how to structure it properly, while Hett was subjected to the [[Embrace of Pain]].<ref name="SWL18" />

When the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] was about to begin and Vergere had left him to join [[Priest/Legends|priestess]] [[Falung]], Hett managed to escape, killing the crew with the dark side. He then destroyed the scout ship, to make the Vong believe he was dead.<ref name="SWL18" />

At the start of the war, scout ships were part of the Yuuzhan Vong fleet that advanced on [[Artorias]].<ref name="Invasion 0, Part 1">[[Invasion 0|''Invasion'' 0]]</ref> A number of these ships also participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|capture of Coruscant]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> At the end of the war, a scout ship was part of a Yuuzhan Vong fleet that died over [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]].<ref name="Legacy 2006 44">[[Legacy (2006) 44|''Legacy'' (2006) 44]]</ref>
